notes:
The window got a working-over.

• Rename a session — click its name in the top bar, or ⌘⇧E. The rail row follows it.
• The Spaces rail is a list: one line per space under its project, foldable, and each row leads with what its agent is doing — a spinner while it works, an amber dot when it needs you.
• Project headers have actions on hover: + starts an agent there, … cuts a worktree or drops the project.
• The status bar is the pane's footer now — project / branch / +N −N. Click the diffstat to open Changes.
• The right tool rail is gone. Its tools are the dock's tabs, and ⌘R opens and closes the dock.
• The diffstat counts new files, so an agent writing untracked files no longer reads as +0 −0.
• Fixed: folding the project you were standing in crashed the app on every launch.
